blocks.text: A duelist's weapon — win fights one opponent at a time through precise single-target bursts and timed defense. Precision here is **timing**, not luck: no crits, no armor-piercing — just reading the fight and hitting the beat.

text: *The Sword is the trace left by **The One Who Answered** — the Unwritten who met every challenge alone, one at a time, and never lost the exchange. Every skill below is a fragment of how they fought.*

blocks.text: **Status:** the Sword's pool is complete — every skill below is built and in the game. Numbers are still in tuning.
Every Sword rolls its kit from this pool: **1 ultimate + a few actives + a few passives**.

blocks.subtitle: One per Sword. 40 MP, and a long cooldown rather than a charge meter.
No button, no mana, no cooldown — each one fires on a moment in the fight.

items: **Deathblow** — swing to build Momentum, keep **Flow** running by staying on one target, then cash it all in one blow. Overclock stacks it faster at the cost of a fragile window.

**Retribution** — Brace to bank the hits you were going to take, then release. **Challenge** stops them walking away from the bank; **Last Stand** hands you more charges exactly when you're about to die. Overclock's doubled incoming damage doubles the bank, turning its drawback into the payoff.

**Blade Dance** — Overclock first: attack speed buys more dance charges, more parries and a faster beat. **Encore** keeps it going on every kill. The doubled damage taken is real — the Parry charges are your only cover.
